title: PPI → AKI after ICI — Co-timing Diagnostics
text:
NoteAbout this page



Renders aggregate results only from cache/*.rds built by data_management.qmd. No patient-level row reaches the output; cells below 11 are suppressed. Follow-up horizon is 730 days.


The time-varying Cox model in analysis.qmd answers one question: is the AKI hazard higher while a patient is on a PPI? It cannot answer a second one: is the PPI doing it? A drug ordered at the same clinical moment as the outcome will look causal to any model that only knows exposure status at each instant.
Three diagnostics separate the two. All of them re-zero the clock on each patient’s own initiation date rather than on the ICI infusion.

1 The mirror window
If a PPI causes AKI, the rate should be flat before the prescription and raised after it. This table places windows on both sides of each initiator’s own PPI date. Person-time is counted over the observation window (last creatinine, death, or horizon) — not the at-risk window, which stops at the AKI and would delete every patient whose AKI came first.

Figure 1: AKI rate per 1,000 person-days by window relative to the first PPI. A drug effect raises only the right-hand side; a shared cause is symmetric.











ImportantHow to read this



The rate in the week before the prescription is close to the rate in the week after it, and the single highest-rate window is the prescription day itself. A drug cannot raise risk in the week before it is taken, so a symmetric peak centred on day 0 points to a shared cause — the acute admission that produces both the stress-ulcer prophylaxis order and the daily creatinine draws.




2 Hazard by time since initiation
Splitting the exposed person-time by how long the patient has actually been on the drug. A pharmacologic effect should persist with continued exposure; an artifact of the ordering encounter should decay.

title: PPI → AKI after ICI — Data Management
text:
NoteAbout this page



Executable specification of the pipeline. Chunks are not run at render time — they read RPDR extracts that stay local. To run:
knitr::purl("data_management.qmd", output = "cache/data_management.R", documentation = 0)
source("cache/data_management.R")
Helpers live in R/ppi_functions.R. Outputs land in cache/ (gitignored); the aggregate cache/qc.rds is what analysis.qmd renders from.


The analysis has four pieces:

Cohort — the 8,911 patients with no PPI at or before ICI start and at least one creatinine afterwards.
Outcome — AKI, computed from each patient’s serial creatinine after the ICI start date.
Exposure — PPI, time-varying. Every patient is unexposed at ICI start (day 0); a patient who fills a PPI on day k becomes exposed from day k.
Follow-up — to the earliest of AKI, last creatinine, death, or 730 days.



1 Setup


Show code
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(data.table); library(survival)
})
source("R/ppi_functions.R")




Show code
CFG <- list(
  master_xlsx = "/Users/to909/Desktop/Meg/Kavita ICI CKD/Final cohort/final_master_0114_raw.xlsx",
  rpdr_dir    = "/Users/to909/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Tianqi Ouyang/CKD after ICI/RPDR",
  rpdr_stem   = "mes98_093025104659807332",
  HORIZON     = 730,          # days -- 2 years
  SMALL_CELL  = 11,
  cache       = "cache",
  REBUILD_RAW = FALSE
)
dir.create(CFG$cache, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
rpdr  <- function(k) file.path(CFG$rpdr_dir, paste0(CFG$rpdr_stem, "_", k, ".txt"))
cpath <- function(x) file.path(CFG$cache, paste0(x, ".rds"))
cached <- function(name, expr) {
  p <- cpath(name)
  if (!CFG$REBUILD_RAW && file.exists(p)) return(readRDS(p))
  v <- force(expr); saveRDS(v, p); v
}
QC <- list()   # aggregate-only; rendered





2 Cohort (8,911)
Start from the ICI-CKD analytic master. Keep only new-users (no PPI on or before ICI) with at least one post-ICI creatinine so AKI is ascertainable.


Show code
master <- read_excel(CFG$master_xlsx) %>%
  standardize_colnames() %>%
  mutate(across(c(ICI_Dose_Date, Date_of_Birth, Date_Of_Death), to_date)) %>%
  distinct(EMPI, .keep_all = TRUE)

baseline <- master %>%
  transmute(
    EMPI, ICI_Dose_Date, Date_Of_Death,
    age_ici, male,
    Race = case_when(Race1 == "White" ~ "White", Race1 == "Black" ~ "Black",
                     Race1 == "Asian" ~ "Asian", TRUE ~ "Other/Unknown"),
    dm, htn, eGFR_CRE_baseline,
    ## Precomputed CKD-composite components (Kavita definition; see make_ckd_composite).
    ckd_incidence, ckd_incidence_date, ckd_progression, ckd_progression_date,
    eskd_defination_1, eskd_defination_1_date, esrd_kt_after_ici, esrd_kt_after_ici_date
  )




Show code
## PPI dispensings. `<=` (baseline) and `>` (initiation) are complementary, so a
## new-user can never also be counted as an initiator.
med <- cached("med_ppi", {
  m <- data.table::fread(rpdr("Med"), sep = "|", quote = "", fill = TRUE,
                         showProgress = FALSE,
                         select = c("EMPI", "Medication_Date", "Medication"))
  m[, Medication_Date := to_date(Medication_Date, "%m/%d/%Y")]
  m[, EMPI := as.character(EMPI)]
  m[grepl(name_regex(PPI_NAMES), Medication, ignore.case = TRUE)][]
})
master_med <- med %>% inner_join(baseline %>% select(EMPI, ICI_Dose_Date), by = "EMPI")

ppi_pre  <- med_baseline(master_med, PPI_NAMES)                       # PPI on/before ICI
ppi_post <- med_first_after(master_med, PPI_NAMES) %>%               # first PPI after ICI
  rename(ppi_first_post_date = first_date)




Show code
## Systemic steroids are the key time-varying confounder: in ICI patients they
## are started to treat immune-related adverse events (including interstitial
## nephritis), and a PPI is routinely co-prescribed alongside them. Without this
## term the PPI coefficient absorbs the steroid indication.
med_ster <- cached("med_steroid", {
  m <- data.table::fread(rpdr("Med"), sep = "|", quote = "", fill = TRUE,
                         showProgress = FALSE,
                         select = c("EMPI", "Medication_Date", "Medication"))
  m[, Medication_Date := to_date(Medication_Date, "%m/%d/%Y")]
  m[, EMPI := as.character(EMPI)]
  m[grepl(name_regex(STEROID_NAMES), Medication, ignore.case = TRUE) &
    !grepl(name_regex(STEROID_EXCLUDE), Medication, ignore.case = TRUE)][]
})

ster_post <- med_ster %>%
  inner_join(baseline %>% select(EMPI, ICI_Dose_Date), by = "EMPI") %>%
  med_first_after_excl(STEROID_NAMES, STEROID_EXCLUDE) %>%
  rename(ster_first_post_date = first_date)




Show code
## Serial creatinine (post-ICI creatinine feeds the AKI outcome; the last
## creatinine at any time defines end of surveillance).
cre <- cached("cre", {
  lab <- data.table::fread(rpdr("Lab"), sep = "|", quote = "", fill = TRUE,
                           showProgress = FALSE,
                           select = c("EMPI", "Seq_Date_Time", "Group_Id", "Result"))
  lab <- lab[Group_Id == "CRE"]
  lab[, `:=`(EMPI = as.character(EMPI),
             cre_date = to_date(Seq_Date_Time, "%m/%d/%Y"),
             cre = parse_lab_numeric(Result))]
  lab[!is.na(cre_date) & !is.na(cre), .(EMPI, cre_date, cre)][]
})

last_cre <- cre %>% group_by(EMPI) %>%
  summarise(last_cre_date = max(cre_date), .groups = "drop")




Show code
ledger <- list(); step <- function(lbl, df) {
  ledger[[length(ledger) + 1]] <<- tibble(step = lbl, n = nrow(df)); df }

coh <- baseline %>% step("ICI-CKD analytic master (as saved)", .) %>%
  filter(is.na(Date_Of_Death) | Date_Of_Death >= ICI_Dose_Date) %>%
    step("- death recorded before ICI start", .) %>%
  anti_join(ppi_pre, by = "EMPI") %>%
    step("- PPI on or before ICI (keep new-users)", .) %>%
  left_join(last_cre, by = "EMPI") %>%
  mutate(last_cre_days = as.numeric(last_cre_date - ICI_Dose_Date)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(last_cre_days), last_cre_days > 0) %>%
    step("- no creatinine after ICI (keep ascertainable)", .)

QC$ledger <- bind_rows(ledger) %>% mutate(removed = lag(n) - n)
stopifnot(nrow(coh) == 8911)          # the analytic cohort





3 AKI outcome (post-ICI creatinine)


Show code
aki <- create_aki(cre, coh %>% select(EMPI, ICI_Dose_Date))

coh <- coh %>% left_join(aki %>% select(EMPI, aki, aki_date, aki_days), by = "EMPI")





3b CKD composite outcome (Kavita definition)
The same CKD composite as the Kavita ICI-CKD project: ESRD/kidney transplant after ICI, or a sustained (>=90 day) eGFR < 10, or incident CKD (baseline eGFR >= 60 with a sustained >30% drop to eGFR < 60), or CKD progression (baseline eGFR < 60 sustained). The component flags and their first-event dates are precomputed in the analytic master; make_ckd_composite() combines them exactly as in Final cohort/Kavita cohort 2026 0130.Rmd.


Show code
coh <- make_ckd_composite(coh)   # adds ckd_composite (0/1) and ckd_days

## Component counts within the new-user cohort (before the horizon is applied).
QC$ckd_components <- tibble(
  component = c("Incident CKD (baseline eGFR>=60)", "CKD progression (baseline eGFR<60)",
                "Sustained eGFR < 10", "ESRD / kidney transplant after ICI",
                "Any CKD composite"),
  n = c(sum(coh$ckd_incidence == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(coh$ckd_progression == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(coh$eskd_defination_1 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(coh$esrd_kt_after_ici == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        sum(coh$ckd_composite == 1))) %>%
  mutate(n = suppress_small_cells(n, CFG$SMALL_CELL))





4 Follow-up & time-varying exposure


Show code
pt <- coh %>%
  left_join(ppi_post,  by = "EMPI") %>%
  left_join(ster_post, by = "EMPI") %>%
  mutate(
    ppi_day    = as.numeric(ppi_first_post_date  - ICI_Dose_Date),
    ster_day   = as.numeric(ster_first_post_date - ICI_Dose_Date),
    death_days = as.numeric(Date_Of_Death - ICI_Dose_Date),
    ## Observation window for the co-timing diagnostics. Unlike fu_days this
    ## does NOT stop at the AKI, so an AKI occurring before the PPI still has
    ## its person-time counted (see mirror_window()).
    obs_days   = pmin(last_cre_days, death_days, CFG$HORIZON, na.rm = TRUE),
    ## Follow-up ends at the earliest of AKI, last creatinine, death, horizon.
    fu_days    = pmin(aki_days, last_cre_days, death_days, CFG$HORIZON, na.rm = TRUE),
    ## Event = AKI within follow-up.
    ev         = as.integer(!is.na(aki_days) & aki_days <= fu_days),
    ## Initiator = starts a PPI while still at risk.
    ppi_initiator = as.integer(!is.na(ppi_day) & ppi_day > 0 & ppi_day < fu_days),

    ## CKD composite -- its own follow-up clock, same time-varying PPI exposure.
    ## Censor at last creatinine / death / horizon (the Kavita censor convention).
    fu_ckd     = pmin(ckd_days, last_cre_days, death_days, CFG$HORIZON, na.rm = TRUE),
    ev_ckd     = as.integer(!is.na(ckd_days) & ckd_days <= fu_ckd),
    ckd_initiator = as.integer(!is.na(ppi_day) & ppi_day > 0 & ppi_day < fu_ckd)
  ) %>%
  filter(fu_days > 0)

## Impute the handful of missing baseline eGFR at the patient level (an
## adjusted model would otherwise silently drop those rows).
if (any(is.na(pt$eGFR_CRE_baseline)))
  pt$eGFR_CRE_baseline[is.na(pt$eGFR_CRE_baseline)] <-
    median(pt$eGFR_CRE_baseline, na.rm = TRUE)

QC$cohort <- tibble(
  n            = nrow(pt),
  ppi_initiators = sum(pt$ppi_initiator),
  never_ppi    = sum(pt$ppi_initiator == 0),
  aki_events   = sum(pt$ev),
  person_years = round(sum(pt$fu_days) / 365.25, 1),
  median_fu_days = median(pt$fu_days)
)

## Steroid co-initiation -- the imbalance the time-varying term exists to absorb.
QC$steroid <- pt %>%
  group_by(group = ifelse(ppi_initiator == 1, "Started PPI", "Never PPI")) %>%
  summarise(n = dplyr::n(),
            started_steroid = sum(!is.na(ster_day) & ster_day <= obs_days),
            pct = round(100 * mean(!is.na(ster_day) & ster_day <= obs_days), 1),
            .groups = "drop")




Show code
## One row per exposure interval: unexposed (0 -> ppi_day) then exposed
## (ppi_day -> end). Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ ppi.
cp <- build_cp_ppi(
  pt %>% transmute(id = EMPI, fu_days, ev, ppi_day,
                   age_ici, male, Race, dm, htn, eGFR_CRE_baseline)
)

## Person-time and crude rate by exposure state.
QC$person_time <- cp %>%
  mutate(days = tstop - tstart) %>%
  group_by(exposure = ifelse(ppi == 1, "On PPI (after initiation)", "Not on PPI")) %>%
  summarise(person_years = round(sum(days) / 365.25, 0),
            aki_events   = sum(event), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(rate_per_100py = round(100 * aki_events / person_years, 1))

## Sanity: exactly the cohort's patients and events survive the split.
stopifnot(dplyr::n_distinct(cp$id) == nrow(pt), sum(cp$event) == sum(pt$ev))




Show code
## Same time-varying PPI split, against the CKD-composite follow-up clock.
cp_ckd <- build_cp_ppi(
  pt %>% transmute(id = EMPI, fu_days = fu_ckd, ev = ev_ckd, ppi_day,
                   age_ici, male, Race, dm, htn, eGFR_CRE_baseline)
)

QC$cohort_ckd <- tibble(
  n              = nrow(pt),
  ppi_initiators = sum(pt$ckd_initiator),
  never_ppi      = sum(pt$ckd_initiator == 0),
  ckd_events     = sum(pt$ev_ckd),
  person_years   = round(sum(pt$fu_ckd) / 365.25, 1),
  median_fu_days = median(pt$fu_ckd)
)

QC$person_time_ckd <- cp_ckd %>%
  mutate(days = tstop - tstart) %>%
  group_by(exposure = ifelse(ppi == 1, "On PPI (after initiation)", "Not on PPI")) %>%
  summarise(person_years = round(sum(days) / 365.25, 0),
            ckd_events   = sum(event), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(rate_per_100py = round(100 * ckd_events / person_years, 1))

stopifnot(dplyr::n_distinct(cp_ckd$id) == nrow(pt), sum(cp_ckd$event) == sum(pt$ev_ckd))





5 Save


Show code
saveRDS(pt,      cpath("pt"))      # patient-level (holds EMPI: local only)
saveRDS(cp,      cpath("cp"))      # counting-process frame -- AKI outcome
saveRDS(cp_ckd,  cpath("cp_ckd"))  # counting-process frame -- CKD composite
saveRDS(CFG,     cpath("cfg"))

walk_ok <- vapply(QC, function(x) if (is.data.frame(x)) { assert_no_phi(x); TRUE } else TRUE,
                  logical(1))
QC$built_at <- Sys.time()
saveRDS(QC, cpath("qc"))

text: Among patients who were not already on a proton-pump inhibitor when they started immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, does starting a PPI raise the hazard of acute kidney injury over the following two years?

title: PPI → AKI after ICI
text: Among patients who were not already on a proton-pump inhibitor when they started immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, does starting a PPI raise the hazard of acute kidney injury over the following two years?

title: PPI → AKI after ICI
text:
Design

Cohort — 8,911 patients with no PPI at or before ICI start and at least one creatinine drawn afterwards.
Outcome — AKI, computed from each patient’s serial creatinine after the ICI start date (KDIGO-style: a creatinine 1.5× the rolling 90-day median, or 0.3 mg/dL above the rolling 2-day minimum).
Exposure — PPI, time-varying. Everyone is unexposed at ICI start (day 0); a patient who fills a PPI on day k becomes exposed from day k, so their pre-PPI follow-up counts as unexposed person-time.
Follow-up — to the earliest of AKI, last creatinine, death, or 730 days.
Model — time-varying Cox, Surv(tstart, tstop, AKI) ~ PPI.

title: PPI → AKI after ICI
text:
What the diagnostics show
The headline time-varying Cox estimate is large and highly significant, but it does not survive inspection as a drug effect:

Mirror window — AKI incidence in the week before the first PPI (6.05 per 1,000 person-days) is essentially the same as the week after (5.98), and peaks on the prescription day itself (14.43). A drug cannot raise risk before it is taken.
Time since initiation — the hazard decays from 9.77 in the first week to 0.99 (0.73–1.33) beyond one year of continued exposure. A nephrotoxin does not become harmless the longer it is taken.
Induction ladder — 2.57 → 1.85 → 1.60 → 1.36 at 0/30/90/180-day lags, monotone with no plateau.
Death negative control — from day 8 onward, starting a PPI predicts death more strongly than it predicts AKI (e.g. 3.12 vs 2.49 at days 31–90).

Together these point to the acute clinical episode in which the PPI is ordered — which also drives the creatinine sampling that makes AKI detectable — rather than to the drug.
